Angle #1 · 5 Cuts · ~35-45s

Pick One From Each Lineup: One Picnic + One Soy Milk

HOOK 1
Main USP
Korea's most-loved everyday drinks · 2 Picnic + 3 Soy · build your combo
Production Method
  1. Lay out all 5 drinks in ONE reveal — 2 Picnic + 3 Maeil soy.
  2. Two quick tastings: soy trio first, then the Picnic pair (no pick during tasting).
  3. After tasting, pick just 2 total — one Picnic + one soy.
  4. Choose + pack them, then drink them at work. End on the CTA.
  5. Keep tastings fast; total ~35-40s.
Scene
Five Korean Drinks Just Showed Up
Direction
Open your delivery and spread all five drinks out at once — 2 Picnic + 3 Maeil soy milks. Say what they are: two of Korea's most-loved everyday drinks that people there have grown up with for years. Gesture across the lineup with genuine 'so many tiny ones' energy, and shoot slightly from above so all five read clearly.

five iconic Korean drinks just showed up 📦
the staples Koreans grew up on 🇰🇷

Scene
Soy Milk Three-Way: Flavor / Clean / Protein
Direction
These are Maeil — Korea's #1 soy milk brand. Line up the three and sip each with one quick tag: Black Soybean — best flavor; Soy 99.9 — cleanest label (soybean, water, salt only); High Protein — most protein, 12g. One line per drink, fast.

Picnic Taste-Off: Apple vs Nectarine
Direction
Picnic is the tiny, cute fruit drink Koreans love. Show both packages — play up how small and adorable the cartons are — and sip each: Apple, sweet and creamy like apple-milk; Nectarine, juicier and peachy. Then tell viewers: now pick just 2 of the 5 — one Picnic and one soy — to carry for the day.

Direction
On camera, choose your final two — one Picnic + one soy — and say why in a word. Pack them into your work bag and lunch box: 'Taking both to work tomorrow.' Slightly elevated angle so bags and drinks stay visible.
